laws.rule: Great Walk huts must be booked in advance on DOC's booking system; international visitors pay higher summer rates (October to April) and DOC staff run random checks at huts. Lake Waikaremoana Track: NZD 35 a hut night for everyone (about A$28.04, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); international children 0 to 4 free.
